name: Regime-armed sector momentum — credit+VIX+macro confluence gate ARMS equity sector trend, risk-off disarms
rationale: Sector/cross-sectional momentum is exhausted standalone because sector leadership rotates and reverses violently in risk-off transitions. The fix is a cross-asset CONFLUENCE GATE rather than a single signal: chase a trending sector ETF (ret_Nd > 0) ONLY while the shared macro/credit/vol regime is benign — credit_spread below a fitted calm level (BOUNDED, flagged +IC in our own scan as the cleanest forward-looking risk gauge), vix_level below a fitted calm ceiling (BOUNDED), AND macro_regime above a fitted supportive floor (BOUNDED composite of curve/real-rates/liquidity). All three must AGREE to arm the entry. Regime-dependent literature (Markov-switching crude/VIX/MOVE studies; 'When Alpha Breaks') shows momentum works in stable regimes and mean-reverts in volatile ones — so when credit is tightening or VIX is elevated the SAME sector momentum should reverse. The book is exited wholesale when the regime gate flips risk-off (credit_spread crosses_up its threshold OR vix_level crosses_up its ceiling), specifically to AVOID the risk-off drawdown that decays ungated momentum. Hedge funds run sector rotation but over-trade it intraday and get chopped in regime transitions; they rarely GATE patient daily sector trend on a multi-signal credit+vol+macro composite over a small ETF set. DISCONFIRMER: run identical sector momentum (1) with NO regime gate and (2) with the gate driven by a non-causal control (noaa_kp_index) instead of credit/vix/macro. If ungated or control-gated sector momentum matches the regime-gated NET deflated Sharpe, the macro gate is decorative and this is plain sector momentum in disguise — the credit+vix+macro gate must add edge specifically by sidestepping the risk-off drawdowns, not by re-expressing the same price trend. Low-confidence until OOS-validated.
catalyst: A sector ETF's daily trend is positive WHILE credit spreads are tight, VIX is calm, and the macro regime is supportive — all three risk-on conditions agree, arming the momentum long; the book exits when credit or VIX crosses up into risk-off.
